classification_definitions.KALSHI_ABSENT_AND_PM_SELECTOR_DISAGREEME: PM event existed under one selector but not the other; no current Kalshi counterpart. Dual-selector enumeration now exposes the disagreement.
classification_definitions.KALSHI_NOT_CURRENTLY_EXECUTABLE: Kalshi counterpart was already settled/finalized or absent while PM still exposed the event; not a current two-venue pair.
classification_definitions.KALSHI_VENUE_ABSENCE: PM listed the match; no current matching open/unopened Kalshi event was enumerated.
classification_definitions.LOCAL_DUPLICATE_SCHEDULE_REPRESENTATION_: The same PM event id appeared twice; exact-id schedule dedupe now collapses compatible duplicates and rejects conflicts.
classification_definitions.LOCAL_IDENTITY_DEFECT_FIXED: Exact audited player alias/xref was missing; both venue events existed.
classification_definitions.LOCAL_TOKEN_BINDING_DEFECT_FIXED: Matcher resolved Miami (FL), but co_listed re-resolved the label without preserving exact event/token binding.
classification_definitions.SCHEDULE_REFERENCE_CONFLICT_BLOCKED: Valencia-Sevilla Kalshi retained Sep 13 while ESPN/current PM referenced Sep 11; exact-time join correctly blocks the unmeasured basis.
classification_definitions.SETTLEMENT_EVIDENCE_AND_ZERO_CAP_BLOCKED: Pair exists, but settlement evidence is unmeasured and effective risk cap is zero.

limitations: The venue-native census uses a loose participant-token/date join and contains known false collisions.
Unregistered rows are research candidates only and never feed operational alerts.
No order books were sampled for capacity.
Counts are point-in-time and listings can change.

methodology.immediate_window: Global census run time minus 3h through plus 6h.
methodology.registered: Every LEAGUES row through schedule, complete venue enumeration, exact matching, settlement, token/fee and risk gates over 48h.
methodology.unregistered: Independent loose participant-token/date join over 48h, excluding Kalshi series in LEAGUES. Rows are UNVERIFIED_COVERAGE_CANDIDATE research leads only; they are not canonical pairs, co-listing assertions, tradeability evidence, or operational alerts.

public_client_health.note: No public-client failure was recorded. Empty selector diagnostics in the full post snapshot exposed a reporting-propagation defect; the following focused UCL probe verifies the repaired relay end to end.

registered_post_fix.note: Public listings changed between snapshots, so aggregates are not a paired experiment. Exact repaired cases were re-probed. CFB now fails closed on newly explicit unmeasured cancellation/postponement rates.

registered_pre_fix.note: 47 rows are 46 unique ids because pm:itf:995780 appeared twice on the old schedule path. immediate=true names the five ATP live/near misses.

scope: Public unauthenticated diagnostics only; no live box, accounts, orders, balances, executable prices, tradeability, or profit claims.

unregistered_loose_candidates_48h.interpretation: The 203 rows and 44 mapping buckets are loose-join candidate counts, not event coverage counts. At least four rows in three mappings are proven false cross-sport/title collisions; every remaining row still requires sport/competition identity, canonical schedule, outcome, settlement, fee, token, executable-book, and risk verification.
